provenance: AUTHORED by rule: every module is composed by a rule in modules/build.py from the registries listed; every step is one of the existing step kinds and every id resolves in the registry that owns it

honesty.standing: Lessons and modules are unverified general practice. Nothing here certifies, qualifies or licenses anybody.
honesty.no_durations: No duration and no credential is stated; none of the source registries declares one.
honesty.greeters: Omega Hive: SCRIPTED, no AI model, the device speech synthesis, on a click, AUTHORED personalities.
honesty.no_new_kinds: No new step kind, episode kind or storage key: lessons, completion and courses are read, never changed.

rules.worksite-district: per union district, the worksites whose crew musters from a first hall of that district; steps are their hand-off evidence (from, then to) in order, duplicates dropped
rules.restoration-site: per walkable restoration site: scenario titles and steps and staged task title and brief quoted verbatim as the brief; steps are the hand-off evidence of worksites at the site, then per needed trade the opening step and first recording step of the first lesson in its union path
rules.wilds-world: per wilds world: the steps of its site walks in site order, copied verbatim from lessons.json
rules.robot-yard: one module: watch the SCRIPTED reference rover in the walkable world (world-teleop, actor scripted-reference), then drive the same env in the Robotics lab (world-teleop, actor human)
rules.greeter: one Omega Hive agent per module; the line is its first greeting line, else its first line
rules.supplements: the module's own lessons, then lessons whose steps run the same seat or ask the same crew, in lessons registry order, at most 6 unless its own lessons are more; each is a courses.json supplement

brief.text: Utility line clearance
A distribution line through the timber: the right-of-way cut back and the line walked for faults.
Trail bridge crew
A timber footbridge over a creek; carpenters framing, labourers packing material in.
Wildfire fuel break
A strip thinned and cleared along a ridge; machines and hand crews working the same ground.
Timber-frame shelter raising
A post-and-beam shelter raised in a clearing; bents lifted and pinned.
Lake intake and main
A raw-water intake at the lake edge feeding a main down the valley.
Fire lookout tower
A steel lookout on the highest knoll; the frame erected and the access scaffold tagged.

brief.text: Run-of-river intake and penstock
A low weir and an intake feeding a penstock down to a small powerhouse; divers work the screens.
Pipeline river crossing
A pipeline crossing the canyon; tie-in digs on each side and a permit closed the way it opened.
Valve vault rescue drill
A buried valve vault on the mesa used for a confined-space entry and retrieval drill.
Mesa-top solar array
Racking and strings laid out across a flat mesa top.
Quarry bench and blast pattern
A stepped quarry face with a drill pattern marked out; everybody knows where not to stand.

places.title: Timber pile trestle over a bayou

brief.text: Levee pump station
A drainage pump station set into the levee; wastewater crews keep the pumps, screens and wet well working.
River terminal berth
A barge berth with a crane working cargo; the lane is briefed before anything swings.
Timber pile trestle over a bayou
A pile-supported trestle across a channel: new piles driven from a rig on firm footing, old bents inspected.
Outfall line and dive station
An outfall pipe running into the channel; a dive team inspects it from a station on the bank.
Spill boom staging
Containment boom and a skimmer staged on the bank, ready to deploy across a channel mouth.
Wind turbine staging yard
A turbine erected on the ridge beside a laydown yard where blades and tower sections wait for the crane.
